t: Joe Wright defends casting of Rooney Mara as Tiger Lily in Peter Pan film | Joe Wright | The Guardian
s: February 22, 2018 - Wright cast black, Indian, Korean and white actors to play the denizens of Neverland, but petitioners point out that the key cast-members are all white, despite Barrie having referred to Tiger Lily and her tribe as “pickaninnies” – a racist term for Native Americans. “This casting choice is particularly shameful for a children’s movie,” reads the online petition. “Telling children their role models must all be white is unacceptable.” · Pan, also starring newcomer Levi Miller as Peter Pan and Garrett Hedlund as Hook, hits UK cinemas on 20 September and debuts in the US on 9 October.
